cases.prompt: Run sw-review on a clean REF workspace
assertions: Exit code is documented and deterministic
No external write occurs
The report names the blocker
The skill stops without inventing approval

cases.prompt: accept FEAT-001 after its criteria changed since the last accept
assertions: The earlier accept line is stale by hash
One fresh plain yes is required
Date or tone is not used as evidence

cases.prompt: accept FEAT-001 while signoff is required
assertions: review.py accept exits 2
A formal sign-off with an approver, role, https URL and hash is asked for

cases.prompt: record a sign-off from a chat message
assertions: Refused unless the manifest allows chat evidence
When allowed, a session reference is recorded
Reads the review backlog from the board and checks every submitted feature
The read-only checks run in parallel and write nothing
Shows one table with each feature's verdict, its draft hash and what blocks it
A blocked feature is listed with its reasons and is not offered for accept
Asks once to accept the listed features, then runs review.py accept --hash for each named one
After the accepts, asks once whether to continue to sw-plan for the accepted features

cases.prompt: Accept FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 from the table, after FEAT-002 was edited
assertions: review.py accept --hash exits 2 for the edited feature and records nothing
The edited feature is reported and excluded; the other one is accepted
A plain yes to the old table is not treated as approval of the new text
